findings.highlight: The only way to kill him would be to crush every trace of his body.
findings.evidenceJa: 跡形もなく肉体を擦り潰すか
findings.governingReading: Body ground to nothing OR3 direct spirit attack, interruptedか at end.
findings.explanation: Alternative physical destruction becomes the only way.

findings.highlight: He was quite attached to his mortality
findings.evidenceJa: 人間にしては強い括りで留まっていた
findings.governingReading: 人間にしては強い括りで留まっていた describes strong continuing binding for human spirit in world.
findings.explanation: Strong binding retaining spirit becomes attachment to mortality.

findings.highlight: but it made him vulnerable to the words of Scripture.
findings.evidenceJa: だが、経典による聖言には弱かろう。
findings.governingReading: だが経典聖言には弱かろう contrasts strong binding with vulnerability to Scripture.
findings.explanation: Strong anchoring despite weakness becomes anchoring causes weakness.

findings.highlight: I am no longer a man, and my heart
findings.evidenceJa: 既に人のモノではない私の心臓は
findings.governingReading: 私の心臓 is subject qualified already not human’s, unusually resistant curses.
findings.explanation: Heart no longer human becomes man no longer human.

findings.highlight: Yes, there will be no eternity for you.
findings.evidenceJa: そう、おまえには永遠にない。
findings.governingReading: Quotation repeats09:90 eternally lacking ordinary happiness09:87, prompting marital recollection.
findings.explanation: Recalled lack of happiness again becomes lack of eternity.

findings.governingReading: 十年以上も前 allows longer interval, emphatic at least over ten.
findings.explanation: More than ten years becomes ten years.

findings.highlight: No one spurns that peace or fails to dream of it.
findings.evidenceJa: その平穏を嫌悪しようと、それを夢見ない人間はいないのだ。
findings.governingReading: 嫌悪しようと all dream of such peace even if they hate it.
findings.explanation: Even despising domestic peace becomes nobody despises it.

findings.highlight: The more he tried to love her, the more she suffered.
findings.evidenceJa: 愛そうとすれば愛そうとするほど、愛する者の苦しみだけが
findings.governingReading: More tries loving, only beloved’s suffering becomes his salvation; scope his source of relief.
findings.explanation: Greater attempted love changes relief in suffering into increased suffering.

findings.highlight: He didn't try to stop her.
findings.evidenceJa: 止めようがなかったし
findings.governingReading: 止めようがなかった states impossibility; separate even-if-stop pointlessness clause follows.
findings.explanation: No way to stop becomes did not try to stop.

findings.highlight: He can't remember her face anymore, never mind her voice.
findings.evidenceJa: あの女の声はおろか、顔さえも思い出せない。
findings.governingReading: 声はおろか顔さえ makes face culminating greater loss after voice.
findings.explanation: Not voice and even face becomes not face never mind voice.

findings.highlight: whenever he found himself dwelling on it.
findings.evidenceJa: その答えが脳裏を掠める時
findings.governingReading: その答えが脳裏を掠める時 specifies almost-arriving answer as trigger for suppression.
findings.explanation: Cuts thought when answer glimmers becomes cuts when dwelling.

findings.highlight: This whole town that doesn't know my suffering.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの痛みも知らず、平穏に過ごす町並み
findings.governingReading: Town unaware of pain lives peacefully, contrast otherworld calm with her captivity.
findings.explanation: Peaceful town life disappears from comparison with her suffering.

findings.highlight: so that you could become its Master.
findings.evidenceJa: アレのマスターを続けさせる為だ。
findings.governingReading: マスターを続けさせる intention keeping already ongoing role,12 same requirement.
findings.explanation: Preserve ongoing Master role becomes become Master.

findings.highlight: The girl crumples to her knees.
findings.evidenceJa: 少女の体がくの字に折れ曲がった。
findings.governingReading: くの字折れ曲がる describes bending body into angle.
findings.explanation: Body folds double becomes falls to knees.
